Description: UpdateDatabaseDdl rejects the table: Error parsing default value expression CAST(NULL AS STRING) from column bitn_to_int64: Expected type INT64; found STRING.
Likely root cause: MariaDB 10.11 returns the string 'NULL' in information_schema COLUMN_DEFAULT for nullable columns without a default (MySQL returns SQL NULL). buildColumn treats it as an explicit default, so every nullable column gets DEFAULT (NULL). PGPrintDefaultValue only adds CAST for FLOAT/NUMERIC/BOOL/BYTEA, so INT8 gets a bare DEFAULT (NULL), which Omni's PostgreSQL dialect types as STRING and rejects. Verified directly against Omni: bigint DEFAULT (NULL) fails, bigint DEFAULT (CAST(NULL AS bigint)) works.
Possible ways to resolve: 1) (Recommended) In buildColumn, treat a COLUMN_DEFAULT of NULL as no default. 2) Add integer and string types to the CAST list in PGPrintDefaultValue. 3) Run the source tests against MySQL instead of MariaDB, which is what upstream CI uses. 4) Check whether real Cloud Spanner accepts the bare default before deciding how much product code to change.
